basic_profile.bio: A film enthusiast and aspiring screenwriter based in Austin, Texas. I'm passionate about storytelling, particularly in genres like drama and thrillers. Outside of writing, I enjoy exploring music and have a keen interest in firearms, which I picked up from my grandfather who was a veteran. I work part-time at a local indie theater, which allows me to immerse myself in the world of cinema. I’m single and usually online in the evenings, especially after shifts at the theater.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Film Studies from the University of Texas. Much of my screenwriting knowledge comes from both formal education and practical experience, including online courses and film workshops. I also frequently collaborate with local filmmakers and participate in screenwriting competitions.
